items.article_text: Pearl Jam's self titled album from 2006 is an awesome listen, and I don't think enough people know or talk about it, because I've rarely heard anyone mention it. This album is PJ's return to their roots, but a continuation of their departure from the "Seattle Sound." I wouldn't call this grunge like I wouldn't call Vitalogy grunge either. Vitalogy was, according to PJ members, a punk rock album, and Pearl Jam (2006) is hard rock, with a pop rock sound mixed in. It's got your heavy-ish sound in songs such as World Wide Suicide, and softer, more melodic sound in songs like Marker In The Sand. It's also quite politically charged, and the delivery of each song's message is very well laid out. Overall, an 8/10 for me. I love this album and if you haven't yet heard it, you might love it too.
